title: Sathiya Sothanai
desc: Pradeep's life turns upside down when he is accused of a murder after discovering the dead body of an influential villager along with some precious jewels.

title: Damaal Dumeel
desc: A young, money-minded IT professional leads a happy life, until he gets fired from his job.

title: Netrikann
desc: Being the prime witness, a former policewoman who cannot see must unveil a horrific case of serial abduction where the culprit has unleashed a reign of terror in the city of Chennai.

title: Cadaver
desc: When two surgeons mysteriously get murdered by Vetri, a prisoner, the responsibility of locating his accomplice falls on the shoulders of a pathologist.

title: Malli Malli Idi Rani Roju
desc: Raja and Khanum's romance is short-lived as she does not return from her trip to Malaysia. Years later, she comes to India and finds Raja, but is shocked to learn about his personal life.

title: Imaikkaa Nodigal
desc: Anjali Vikramadithyan, a CBI officer, sets out to track down a serial killer who the police claim was killed years ago. However, the investigation becomes personal when the killer targets her family.

title: Subham
desc: The women of Bheemili are unusually transfixed by a soap opera serial. When three friends who run the cable in town decide to dig into the situation, they uncover unimaginable secrets.

title: Bruce Lee 2 the Fighter
desc: Kartik sacrifices his studies for his sister and becomes a stuntman. But he ends up helping a cop to unearth the evil designs of Deepak.

title: Naan Local
desc: Babu, a carefree graduate, falls in love with Keerthy, his classmate, and pursues a relationship with her. However, her father doesn't approve of their union and wants her to marry a successful man.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Seedan
desc: Mano is in love with Maha, a maid, in his grandmother's house, but lacks the courage to confess to his mother. After his marriage is fixed, a distraught Maha vents her anger in Lord Murugan's temple.

title: Pa. Pandi
desc: Pandian Pazhanisami, a retired man, misses his youthful days and embarks on a mission to find his first love and reconnect with her.

title: Ragasiya Kolayaali
desc: Anwar is a consulting criminologist who helps the Kerala Police occasionally. When a string of serial killings happen in quick succession, he must race against time to find the one responsible.

title: Premalu
desc: Having been rejected once, Sachin, a young man, falls for Reenu, a girl he meets during a wedding and sets out to win her over.

title: Jagame Thandhiram
desc: Suruli, a gangster, goes to London and becomes embroiled in several criminal activities, but the stakes rise when he falls in love with a singer named Attila.

title: Maari
desc: Maari, a criminal, constantly troubles the people in his locality and extorts money from them. But his life changes when Sridevi, a pretty woman, falls in love with him.

title: Maaran
desc: Mathimaran, an honest journalist, exposes a fraud by Pazhani, a politician. As a result, it lands his career in trouble, while also threatening his family's safety.
